title: Grateful Dead Live at The Matrix on 1966-12-01
lineage: Tascam DA-20 mkII>SB Audigy>SF 6.0>CD Wave>mkwACT>SHN>Sound Forge 11>Flac

ai_review.summary: High‑energy show where every tune shines – especially One Kind Favor – with an acceptable but undocumented recording quality.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave that the concert is nonstop fire, calling every song a highlight and noting Garcia’s playful lick in One Kind Favor. No complaints about the audio were mentioned, suggesting the recording is at least listenable. Overall it’s a thrilling performance despite the lack of technical details.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic reviews give 4‑5 stars and praise the musical performance heavily, with no negative comments about sound; this yields a high combined rating despite limited data on recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers did not comment on clarity, mix, or source type, implying no noticeable problems and an overall acceptable listening experience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Listeners felt the entire set was consistently exciting with no weak moments.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar work is highlighted for a fun lick reuse in One Kind Favor and praised throughout the show.
